summary: Completed backend+frontend validation for unmoderated catalogue, cheapest-paid fallback routing, live free and live paid inference, and about:blank launcher behavior on preview URL.
action_items: No production blocker found in tested scope.
Optional cleanup: update /app/memory/test_credentials.md policy notes still describing historical free-only behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical implementation defects found in tested backend/frontend flows.
Earlier popup smoke timeout is test-harness method mismatch (parent popup expectation) rather than app bug; context.page capture validates real launcher behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed live paid verification with controlled catalogue override boundary: selected dynamic cheapest eligible paid model from live /api/chat/models, then real /api/chat/completions inference succeeded with is_paid=true and single paid attempt. Verified launcher opens about:blank wrapper for all three header labels, iframe src lands on expected routes (/notes,/web,/library), popup.opener is null, blocked window.open shows visible dismissible error, keyboard Enter activation opens wrapper. Chat UI confirmed policy banner text, free-preference model picker behavior (16 free options shown), and live response rendering with attempts/cost metadata.
rca of the issue: No product defect RCA required for this run. The previously reported popup smoke timeout reproduces when relying only on parent expect_popup flow; opener-null + wrapper setup can make that harness path flaky. Using browser context page enumeration/event capture confirms the real behavior is working.

main_agent_followup.docs: Updated test_credentials.md, PRD.md, README.md, RENDER_SETUP.md to current unmoderated-listed/free-first/single-cheapest-paid policy and about:blank behavior; historical free-only notes superseded.
